license_required.quote: No person, whether an individual or a business organization, shall have the right to engage in the business of residential contracting or commercial general contracting without a current, valid residential contractor license or commercial general contractor license, respectively, issued by the division under this chapter

issuing_authority.value: State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors.

name.value: State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors
name.quote: "Board" means the State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors.

type.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors consisting of 15 members appointed by the Governor for five-year terms.

umbrella_agency.value: Secretary of State's office / Professional Licensing Boards Division
umbrella_agency.quote: The board shall be assigned to the Secretary of State's office for administrative purposes and shall be under the jurisdiction of the division director

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 21 years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: Is of a good character and is otherwise qualified as to competency, ability, integrity, and financial responsibility;

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree from an accredited four-year college or university in engineering, architecture, construction management, building construction, or other acceptable field (for residential-light commercial and commercial general); or combination of academic credits and experience; or experience alone
degree_required.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited four-year college or university in the field of engineering, architecture, construction management, building construction, or other field acceptable to the division

degree_level.quote: Has a total of at least four years of proven active experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor, predominantly in the residential-basic category, or other proven experience deemed substantially similar by the division

approximate.matched_normalized: experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor predominantly in the residential basic category or other proven experience deemed substantially similar by the division

school_approval_basis.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited four-year college or university

credential_pegged.quote: Anyone seeking to be licensed as a residential contractor or as a commercial general contractor in this state shall file an application on a form provided by the residential contractor or commercial general contractor division

tiers.quote: Has at least two years of proven experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor, predominantly in the residential-basic category, or other proven experience deemed substantially similar by the division

Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited four-year college or university in the field of engineering, architecture, construction management, building construction, or other field acceptable to the division and has at least one year of proven experience

Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited four-year college or university in the field of engineering, architecture, construction management, building construction, or other field acceptable to the division and has at least one year of proven experience working as or in the employment of a commercial general contractor

required.quote: Has at least two years of proven experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor, predominantly in the residential-basic category

experience_source.quote: Has at least two years of proven experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor, predominantly in the residential-basic category, or other proven experience deemed substantially similar by the division

duration.quote: Has a total of at least four years of proven active experience working in a construction industry related field, at least two of which shall have been as or in the employment of a residential contractor

kind.value: proven experience working as or in the employment of a contractor
kind.quote: proven experience working as or in the employment of a residential contractor, commercial general contractor, or other proven experience deemed substantially similar by the division

exams.name: Residential-Basic Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of residential contracting, building codes, estimating costs, construction, ethics, workers' compensation, insurance, and liens. May be waived for reciprocity or prior licensees.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered or approved by the residential contractor division)
exams.quote: The residential contractor division shall conduct or cause to be conducted separate examinations for applicants for residential-basic and residential-light commercial licenses

exams.name: Residential-Light Commercial Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of residential-light commercial contracting. May be waived for reciprocity or prior licensees.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered or approved by the residential contractor division)
exams.quote: The residential contractor division shall conduct or cause to be conducted separate examinations for applicants for residential-basic and residential-light commercial licenses

exams.name: Commercial General Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of commercial general contracting, building codes, estimating costs, surety bonding, liens, insurance. May be waived for reciprocity or prior licensees. Third or subsequent failure requires waiting at least one calendar year.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered or approved by the commercial general contractor division)
exams.quote: The commercial general contractor division shall conduct or cause to be conducted an examination to ascertain the particular applicant's ability to make a practical application of his or her knowledge of the profession of commercial general contracting

interval_years.quote: Such licenses shall be renewable biennially.

required.quote: As a condition of renewal, the appropriate division may require licensees to complete division approved continuing education of not more than three hours annually for a residential-basic license, six hours annually for a residential-light commercial license, and eight hours annually for a commercial general contractor license.

hours_per_period.quote: not more than three hours annually for a residential-basic license, six hours annually for a residential-light commercial license, and eight hours annually for a commercial general contractor license

period_years.quote: not more than three hours annually for a residential-basic license, six hours annually for a residential-light commercial license, and eight hours annually for a commercial general contractor license

available.quote: Provide by regulation for reciprocity with other states or territories of the United States in the licensing of residential and commercial general contractors, provided that such other states have requirements substantially equal to the requirements in force in this state

requirements.value: Other state must have substantially equivalent requirements; applicant must hold a current valid license from that state; criteria for that state's license must have been substantially equivalent to Georgia's; application materials and exam results must be available for review; applicant must demonstrate Georgia qualifications and comply with all Georgia requirements; similar privilege must be offered to Georgia residents by the other state.
requirements.quote: The criteria for issuance of such license or certification by such other state or territory, including the requirement to successfully complete an examination, were substantially equivalent to Georgia's current license criteria

exists.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors consisting of 15 members appointed by the Governor for five-year terms.

regulatory_model.quote: No person, whether an individual or a business organization, shall have the right to engage in the business of residential contracting or commercial general contracting without a current, valid residential contractor license or commercial general contractor license, respectively, issued by the division under this chapter

credential_type.quote: the appropriate division shall issue to the applicant a license to engage in business as a residential or commercial general contractor in this state

is_mandatory.quote: No person, whether an individual or a business organization, shall have the right to engage in the business of residential contracting or commercial general contracting without a current, valid residential contractor license or commercial general contractor license

title_protection.quote: Falsely represents, advertises, or holds himself or herself or an affiliated business organization out as a residential contractor or commercial general contractor licensee duly authorized to perform work under such classification of licensure pursuant to this chapter

scope_protection.quote: No person, whether an individual or a business organization, shall have the right to engage in the business of residential contracting or commercial general contracting without a current, valid residential contractor license or commercial general contractor license, respectively, issued by the division under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by fraud or misrepresentation or knowingly giving false or forged evidence to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a license by fraud or misrepresentation or otherwise knowingly giving false or forged evidence to the board or its divisions;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony directly related to contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal act constituting a felony in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of residential or commercial general contracting or the ability to practice contracting;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act that assists an unlicensed person in unlicensed contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in the prohibited unlicensed practice of contracting if the licensee knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity is unlicensed;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person by allowing one's license to be used to evade provisions of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person by allowing his or her license to be used with the intent to evade the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of the chapter or violating a rule, regulation, or lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter or violating a rule, regulation, or lawful order of the board or its divisions;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a construction project without just cause and without proper notification to the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor who is the individual license holder or a business organization for whom the license holder is a qualifying agent is engaged or under contract as a residential or commercial general contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely indicating work is bonded, payments have been made, or insurance is provided
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded; knowingly and falsely indicating by written statement issued to the owner that payment has been made for all subcontracted work, labor, and materials; or falsely indicating that workers' compensation and general liability insurance are provided;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting, including falsely advertising or holding out as licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting, including falsely advertising, representing, or holding himself or herself or an affiliated business organization out as having a valid and current license under this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated or persistent negligence, or negligence resulting in significant danger to life or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence, repeated or persistent negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building permits and inspections
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building permits and inspections;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or attempting to use a license that has expired or has been suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use a license that has expired or has been suspended or revoked;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or intentionally engaging a subcontractor to perform work requiring a Chapter 14 license when the subcontractor lacks that license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or intentionally engaging any subcontractor to perform work within the scope of the general or residential construction contract which requires a license under Chapter 14 of this title who does not possess a current and valid license for such work;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a final civil judgment relating to the practice of the licensee's profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a final civil judgment obtained against the licensee or the business organization qualified by the licensee relating to the practice of the licensee's profession.

insurance_required.quote: All applicants shall provide proof of general liability insurance in an amount specified by the appropriate division and proof of workers' compensation insurance as required by the laws of this state.

definition_quote.value: "Contractor," except as specifically exempted by this chapter, means a person who is qualified, or required to be qualified, under this chapter and who contracts to, offers to undertake or undertakes to, submits a bid or a proposal to, or personally or by others performs the construction or the management of the construction for an owner of any building, bridge, or other structure

methods_authorized.quote: performs the construction or the management of the construction for an owner of any building, bridge, or other structure, including a person who installs industrialized buildings

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: The parties to the warranty may agree to submit any or all disputes arising under the warranty to arbitration. Such agreement to arbitrate shall be enforceable as provided in Part 1 of Article 1 of Chapter 9 of Title 9, the "Georgia Arbitration Code."

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: where the total value of the work or activity or of the compensation to be received by the contractor for such activity or work, whichever is the higher, exceeds $2,500.00

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: no municipality or county may require any such person licensed under this chapter to comply with any additional licensing requirements imposed by such municipality or county relative to the performance of construction work subject to the licensing requirements under this chapter

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: nothing in this chapter shall preclude the implementation and enforcement by any municipality or county of a local rule, regulation, ordinance, order, or other requirement in effect and operation as of July 1, 2004, that requires a person to obtain a locally issued license, registration, or certification

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Such licenses shall be renewable biennially.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: any contract entered into on or after July 1, 2008, for the performance of work for which a residential contractor or commercial general contractor license is required by this chapter and not otherwise exempted under this chapter and which is between an owner and a contractor who does not have a valid and current license required for such work in accordance with this chapter shall be unenforceable in law or in equity by the unlicensed contractor.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
